about_the_game:
MAKE YOUR DREAMS COME TRUE

A vampyr haunts your dreams. She’s not just any vampyr though: she’s Vicca von Nostro.  Every time you close your eyes, you can’t stop envisioning her. She’s so perfect, you’d do ANYTHING to be with her. 

You decide that you’re fed-up with simply dreaming about love, you need the real deal. To do so, you must travel to Castle Helenox – the foreboding castle where Vicca lives – in order to deliver your personal love letter. 

Explore the dangerously uninviting corridors of Castle Helenox and try not to die as you seek out the ultimate vampyr love story. 

KEY FEATURES 

  • SURVIVAL HORROR GAMEPLAY - Use stealth and resource management mechanics to avoid and escape frightening enemies 

  • MULTIPLE ENDINGS - Decide your fate through dialogue and character choices

  • TENSE ATMOSPHERE - Navigate the unsettling castle environment, where every shadow hides terror 

  • IMMERSIVE GRAPHICS - High quality graphics powered by Unreal Engine 5 provide you with a terrifying world to explore

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains intense scenes and gore that may be disturbing to some players

short_description: Love bites … especially when you’re in love with a Vampyr. In this survival horror game, travel to the ominous ruins of Castle Helenox in order to deliver your personal love letter to the monster who stole your heart. After all, who said that love has to be a pain in the neck?
